highlights.label: The artist
highlights.title: Meet Piepmatz
highlights.copy: Disabled bird. Serious artist. Massive personality. Her human has been reassigned to management, documentation, publicity and general servitude.

highlights.label: At work
highlights.title: Artist at work
highlights.copy: Every mark is made by Piepmatz. The process is physical, unpredictable and conducted under strict avian creative direction.

highlights.label: Archive
highlights.title: The early period
highlights.copy: The practice began in 2024. The archive now holds more than 124 works across distinct periods, materials and moods.

highlights.label: Feathers
highlights.title: Material studies
highlights.copy: Found feathers occasionally enter the work. Whether this is mixed media or aggressive self-branding remains under curatorial review.

highlights.label: Collected
highlights.title: 31 works collected
highlights.copy: Thirty-one works have already left the studio. The artist has made no public statement about the separation.

highlights.label: The human
highlights.title: Studio management
highlights.copy: Jana is the artist's human, archivist, gallery assistant and unpaid press office. Piepmatz considers this arrangement adequate.

portraitAddOn.name: Portrait with the artist
portraitAddOn.description: A digital portrait of Piepmatz with up to three selected items from this order, delivered by email and/or shared in tagged Instagram and TikTok Stories.
